    blockrows=[r for r in range(len(I)) if any(v==2 for v in I[r])]
    blockcols=[c for c in range(len(I[0])) if any(I[r][c]==2 for r in range(len(I)))]

    for (mr,mc) in mk:
        # find intersection with block rectangle: parametric from marker toward block
        rr=[r for r in blockrows]; cc=[c for c in blockcols]
        # enter block from marker side
        # choose entry row/col closest to marker
        if mr < min(rr): entry_r=min(rr)
        elif mr > max(rr): entry_r=max(rr)
        else: entry_r=mr
        if mc < min(cc): entry_c=min(cc)
        elif mc > max(cc): entry_c=max(cc)
        else: entry_c=mc
        # direction from marker to (entry_r,entry_c); extend beyond block: total length = ?
        dr,dg = entry_r-mr, entry_c-mc
        print(' ',(mr,mc),'near corner',(entry_r,entry_c),'dir',(dr,dg))
        # how far does beam extend in O? collect O==2 cells beyond block along this dir
        far=[]
        tr,tc=mr+dr,mc+dg
        while 0<=tr<len(O) and 0<=tc<len(O[0]):
            if O[tr][tc]==2: far.append((tr,tc))
            else: break
        print('   beam cells:',far[:4],'count',len(far))

import json
def f(inp):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    rect=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==2]
    rs=[r for r,_ in rect]; cs=[c for _,c in rect]
    r0,r1_,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    ones=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==1]
    O=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for r in range(r0,r1_+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1): O[r][c]=2
    # classify markers by side
    for r,c in ones:
        if r<r0:   # top: block columns
            for rr in range(0,r0):
                if c0<=c<=c1: O[rr][c]=2
        elif r>r1_: # bottom: block columns
            for rr in range(r1_+1,H):
                if c0<=c<=c1: O[rr][c]=2
        elif c<c0: # left: block rows
            for cc in range(0,c0):
                if r0<=r<=r1_: O[r][cc]=2
        else:      # right: block rows
            for cc in range(c1+1,W):
                if r0<=r<=r1_: O[r][cc]=2
    return O
di=G['Demo pair 3 input']; do=G['Demo pair 3 output']
print(f(di)==do)
O=f(G['Test input'])
for row in O: print(''.join(map(str,row)))
print(json.dumps(O))

def load_from_file(f):
    t=open(f,encoding='utf8',errors='ignore').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
